source_integration_method: exact separable integral over binary QSGS Ag voxels; contributions to round-off-only projected cells are omitted
limitations: Heat is deposited directly into lattice enthalpy; this is not TTM or TTM-MD.
Candidate properties are first-pass values pending source-table archival and citation review.
Boundary A/B are limiting assumptions, not measured Ag/Ti3SiC2 interface heat transfer.
External z faces are insulated and x/y are periodic; no free-surface radiation or convection is included.

sampled_liquid_persistence_screen.interpretation: Provisional user-defined screening only. It measures consecutive sampled presence of any connected liquid cluster, not persistent identity of one tracked cluster; it is not a universal stability criterion.
